provenance.note: Hypothetical temple alignment; OSM footprints, DEM ground; untagged building heights estimated.

osm.unitsFinding: feature points and terrain heights are in AMOT at 0.5 m (metresPerAmah 0.5), not metres; see alignment proof

inputs.alignmentRule: UE_cm = ((x_amot + SOURCE_ALIGN_X_AMOT) * 50, (y_amot - SOURCE_ALIGN_Z_AMOT) * 50); source axes east/south; UE X east, Y south

domeOfTheRock.note: The exporter's "hypothetical temple alignment" evidently placed this centroid at exactly X -6300, Y 0: the Kodesh HaKodashim was aligned on the Dome when the city was exported.

offsetFromDomeCentre.value: UNVERIFIED: no plan with the rock's centre coordinates could be fetched offline (ritmeyer.com and madainproject.com refused automated fetches)
offsetFromDomeCentre.reasoning: the rock (~13 m across its short axis) lies inside the ~20.4 m drum circle, so its centre cannot be more than (20.4 - 13)/2 = 3.7 m from the drum centre

rock.ritmeyerArkDepression: Ritmeyer reports a rectangular cutting on the rock of about 2.5 x 1.5 cubits (4 ft 4 in x 2 ft 7 in) which he places at the centre of his Holy of Holies; its position on the rock was not retrievable here and is NOT used numerically.

elevation.demNote: The DEM is a surface model: over the Dome it returns roof/drum-biased heights, not the rock. It cannot locate the rock summit; the published 743.7 m figure is used instead.

kodeshFloorIfAronRestsOnRock.rule: Mishnah Yoma 5:2 / Rambam Beit HaBechirah 4:1: the stone stood three etzbaot above the Kodesh HaKodashim floor; the Aron rested on the stone
kodeshFloorIfAronRestsOnRock.status: NOT part of the XY alignment; a separate vertical-datum decision. Lowering the Temple ~13.5 m would put the court platform (Z 300 top) at about 734-735 m, below the present esplanade (~740 m per Wikipedia Temple Mount), and would invalidate the Mount deck / terrain cut / Kotel joins.

actorSets.note: Main-map inventory of 2026-09-08T13:31Z; later work added actors (paroches, tour markers, crowd field, service, transit). The release script classifies live and refuses unknown actors.

A_translateTemple.cost: moves the whole Temple actor set (about 2898 static-mesh actors in the main inventory plus PlayerStart, cameras, lights, residents, sound, tour markers, crowd-field/service/FX actors added later); every file in hardcodedTempleCoordinates must change or route through the scene-units frame
A_translateTemple.why: the terrain was cut for the Mount deck ring (X -213..150 m, Y -252..260 m), not for the +-81 m court platform; a few metres of court-platform translation stays on the deck

B_translateCityAndTerrain.cost: moves about 4858 context actors (streets, buildings, 256 terrain tiles, Old City facades/infill, Kotel families, mount access, bus, platform, ISM actors), plus 4 metric crowd zones, transit stops, bird perches, and re-origins SOURCE_ALIGN_X_AMOT in create_mount_enclosure.py / mount-platform-design.json ("alignment already baked in native meshes; NEVER apply twice") and every Kotel manifest/receipt that records world bounds
B_translateCityAndTerrain.breaksIdentityGuards: release_kotel_stone_v2.py, release_kotel_surface_polish.py and release_place_assets.py refuse a Kotel base wall that is not at identity; context meshes carry world coordinates baked at identity
B_translateCityAndTerrain.breaksTerrainCut: no (deck and terrain move together) but the FutureMountV1 map L_FutureMount and its receipts go stale
B_translateCityAndTerrain.preserves: all Temple hardcodes (C++ and specs) and every Temple receipt

recommendation.main50: DO NOT MOVE. The Aron footprint centre (-6200, 0) is 100 cm from the Dome of the Rock centroid (-6300, 0); the rock's own centre is not known better than about 4.2 m from OSM data, so the requested alignment is already satisfied within the evidence. A 1 m translation would touch ~2898 actors, 11 C++ files (6 runtime + 5 tests) and 39 scripts/specs for a change no source can confirm.
recommendation.candidate48: Route A as a RE-PIVOT, when the candidate is next touched: translate the converted Temple set by (-248, 0, 0) cm and set the Selected48 descriptor FixedArchitectureOriginCm to (-6200, 0, 0). This undoes the systematic 248 cm eastward drift the origin pivot introduced and puts the candidate Aron back at X -6200 (the same 100 cm residual as main), while keeping the runtime frame representable. Do NOT chase the remaining 100 cm on either map. Route B is rejected: more actors, breaks the baked-alignment invariant and the Kotel identity guards, and stales the terrain/Kotel receipts.
recommendation.vertical: Separate decision: the Aron floor is ~13.5 m above the published rock summit; see elevation.kodeshFloorIfAronRestsOnRock. Not applied by any script here.
